media.todoReplacement: New candidate must differ from v8 todo-present-alpha.webm. Unilateral downward presentation, no bilateral chest curl/deep crouch/bright repeated crease ridges; original fps and resolution retained.
media.song: Verify actual decoded playback progression and nonzero signal, not rotating vinyl or simulated timers. Preserve official-preview identity and label; native phone result remains separate.
media.transitions: Keep last decoded character frame until next actual frame. No blank canvas, opaque gray poster or obsolete card during decision/rapid interruption.
media.shadow: Foot shadow remains present through every character action.

verificationBoundaries.fixture: Synthetic classification/ASR input proves only app consumption and interruption handling.
verificationBoundaries.realDeepSeek: Requires owner's private phone-entered Key and actual provider response. Never infer from fixture.
verificationBoundaries.physicalSpeech: Requires physical microphone capture and correct final text on STEPX Neo. Desktop or audio-file model decoding is insufficient.
verificationBoundaries.assetAcceptance: Coordinator inspection is candidate QA, not final user visual approval.
